intent.summary: After a user clicks “Add to SQLite” once, subsequent popup opens on the same domain auto-store extractions (including different url patterns) and reflect Saved state in UI.
intent.whyNow: Users expected domain-level opt-in to persist; requiring repeated manual clicks across page types was confusing and slowed workflows.

decisions.title: Auto-capture location
options: Move auto-capture into Preview (auto-click existing action)
decisions.decision: Move auto-capture into Preview and remove App-level auto-capture.
decisions.rationale: Preview owns action/status UI; one code path avoids double writes and makes behavior visible.

decisions.title: Opt-in persistence ordering
options: Store extraction first, then enable domain
Enable domain first, then store extraction
decisions.decision: Enable domain first, then store extraction.
decisions.rationale: User intent is explicit; persisting the toggle first prevents losing opt-in if popup closes quickly or store fails.

commandsRun: npx playwright test tests/extension/sqlite-autocapture.spec.ts -g "manual opt-in enables domain auto-capture"
testsRun: npx playwright test tests/extension/sqlite-autocapture.spec.ts -g "manual opt-in enables domain auto-capture"

evidence.notes: Playwright E2E opt-in test passes; auto-capture is visible via Preview Saved state and guarded against duplicates.

followUps: Consider surfacing an explicit setting toggle in the popup for the current domain (optional UX improvement).
